subject: After-hours call intake
intro: When a customer calls after closing, your office will have their name, callback number and reason for calling before the next shift starts.

items.detail: Write the greeting, collect caller details and route each summary to dispatch.
Test routine requests and urgent callbacks with your dispatcher.
Walk the office through a callback and leave a one-page reference.

terms: This covers setup and handoff. We’ll quote any ongoing call service separately.
next_step: To move ahead, reply with the name of the dispatcher who will join the test calls.
